query.text: 请看着我按菜谱烘焙，这次面粉只取一勺，如果我再取，请提醒我纠正。
query.text_en: Please watch me bake according to the recipe. I should take only one scoop of flour this time; if I take another, please correct me.

annotation.text_zh: 您已经取过一勺面粉了，请先不要再取第二勺。
annotation.text_en: You have already taken one scoop of flour, please do not take a second scoop yet.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
